subject: st-jonahs
q: The Survivors list — who was actually in St. Jonah's?
detail:
VIRAENA HOLDS A PROPER LIST AND WILL HAND IT OVER WHEN SHE FINDS IT AGAIN. Until it arrives, the Archive's survivor fields are a patchwork: some girls carry a flight and an ID, some carry CIVILIAN, and at least one — ALICE — was read as unharmed on the strength of that word when she was nothing of the sort.

WHEN THE LIST LANDS it should be treated as authoritative over every survivor field currently in the file, including the ones that look confident. The flights and IDs the Archive holds came in piecemeal across many sessions and none of them have ever been checked against a single source.

UNTIL THEN: a blank survivor field means the Archive was not told, and nothing more than that.

ANSWERED 7 SEPTEMBER. The list arrived. Twenty-nine names across three houses, and the file was already right about seventy-one of seventy-two. See c-survivors-list. RETIRED.
